title: Include skill assets in installed scaffold
goal: Ensure projects initialized through the packaged harness receive every file referenced by its local skills.
in_scope: Include requirements-interview assets in the packaged templates and initialized target repository.
Update package configuration so nested skill assets are included in built distributions.
out_of_scope: Changing the content or interview workflow of the requirements-interview skill.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh `harness init` creates both functional and non-functional requirements templates under `.agents/skills/requirements-interview/assets/`.
The source distribution and wheel include those assets so both `uvx` and `uv tool install` can initialize the complete skill.
Existing target files remain preserved by repeatable initialization.
verification: Inspect the built wheel and source archive for both requirements-interview asset files.
